240-5470-6633-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

3490-6723-7075-8201.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-7075-8201.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2577-4247-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4247-6763-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

277-2577-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3593-3899-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
3593-3899-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

728-1734-3175.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

433-5621-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

305-4644-7791.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.

1879-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2724-3987-6568.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Y'shtola Rhul. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2525-3358-7297.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Earth Kingdom General

338-1409-2060-7085.description:
Activate Earth Kingdom General by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Earth Kingdom General.
Resolve the Earth Kingdom General trigger, causing you to earthbend a land, thus putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Earth Kingdom General's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2374-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

109-232-1235-2187.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4344-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1339-1808-2921-6625.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1657-6258.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 2.

4863-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Revolutionist each turn.
4863-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Revolutionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-4862-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4862-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4475-6004.easyPrerequisites: Grievous Wound attached to an opponent.
4475-6004.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to the opponent that has Grievous Wound attached to them.
4475-6004.description:
Deal damage to the opponent that has Grievous Wound attached to them.
Grievous Wound triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent with Grievous Wound attached loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1479-2232-3604.notablePrerequisites:
An additional nonartifact permanent card in your hand that you are able to play.
An additional nonartifact permanent card on the battlefield that shares a type with the card in your hand and that has an equal or lesser mana cost.
1479-2232-3604.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Kodama of the East Tree enters the battlefield, Cadric and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, declining to use it.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, paying {1} to create a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 7 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 5 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 9, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 6, putting the permanent you returned in step 10 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

717-779-3251-4048.description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Whirlwind of Thought triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1574-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Rot-Tide Gargantua either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1302-4658.notablePrerequisites:
Catapult Captain does not have summoning sickness.
You have a higher life total than an opponent.
1302-4658.description:
Activate Catapult Captain by paying {2}{B}, tapping it, and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing target opponent with a lower life total than you to lose life equal to its toughness.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2557-3705-4050-4871.description:
Sacrifice Squee to Phyrexian Altar, gaining {R}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two treasure tokens.
Use the floating {R} and treasures to recast Squee.
Repeat.
